task: I get monthly cable bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "cable bill [MM-YY]" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.
